primary.outcome: Sum of four native loss components per simulator step; lower is better
primary.ci: Percentile crossed bootstrap of whole simulator seed tables and whole common attack paths; conditional on frozen calibration
primary.p_values: Approximate centered two-sided bootstrap null p-values; Holm adjusted across six primary comparisons
primary.estimand: Expected native total loss over new simulator-seed and common-path distributions, conditional on frozen calibration
primary.shared_resampling: Identical simulator-row and attacker-path resampling draws for all primary contrasts
primary.primary_decision: Call a primary advantage supported when the Bonferroni simultaneous percentile interval lies strictly below zero; Holm p-values are additional approximate inference
primary.stopping: Collect all specified seeds and paths; no significance-based early stopping or sample-size extensions

secondary.multiplicity: Secondary findings are descriptive; primary decisions use the six-comparison family only

fixed_choices.defender_policies: Original six frozen policies, no revisions or held-out tuning
fixed_choices.normalization: Original a priori CAGE component bounds
fixed_choices.safe_budget: Original manuscript 6 sqrt(K-1) T^(3/4); no threshold tuning
fixed_choices.mixture: Expected outcomes of independently reset complete-policy episodes

exclusions.old_pilot_test_seeds: All 40 original test seeds excluded from new primary analysis
exclusions.calibration_uncertainty: Primary CI conditional on original training fit; three new fits descriptive robustness only
exclusions.scope: Official CAGE 2 simulator, model-informed policy selection, attack mode disclosed after choice, frozen Red tactics; not deployed attack logs
exclusions.interactive: Methods induce different paths under one causal attacker rule; not an identical-path comparison
